crossRefs.note: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy. I will praise you on the harp, God, my God.
Let my meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in Yahweh.
Will he delight himself in the Almighty, and call on God at all times?
For he has said, ‘It profits a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.’
As the apple tree among the trees of the wood, so is my beloved among the sons. I sat down under his shadow with great…
then you will delight yourself in Yahweh, and I will make you to ride on the high places of the earth, and I will feed…
whom, not having known, you love. In him, though now you don’t see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy…
The king rejoices in your strength, Yahweh! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!
You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips.
He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.
If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.
You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should…
This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.
And if we know that he listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.

translations.web: Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
translations.bsb: Delight yourself in the LORD, and He will give you the desires of your heart.
translations.kjv: Delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.
translations.asv: Delight thyself also in Jehovah; And he will give thee the desires of thy heart.
